title: Prophet Yusuf
description: The well, the dream, the prison and the palace — the best of stories.

questions.prompt: Name something from the story of Prophet Yusuf (AS) in the Qur'an.

notAccepted.message: That's in the question — name something else from the story!

answers.explanation: His brothers threw Yusuf into the bottom of a well.
Jealous of their father's love for him, his brothers plotted against him.
His father, the Prophet Ya'qub, who grieved for him for years.

answers.canonical: The dream of the eleven stars
answers.explanation: As a boy he dreamt of eleven stars, the sun and the moon prostrating to him.
His brothers brought back his shirt stained with false blood; later his shirt restored his father's sight.
He was sold in Egypt and rose to high office there.
The brothers claimed a wolf had eaten him.
Though innocent, he chose prison over sin and spent years there.
She tried to seduce him; tradition names her Zulaykha.
Travellers lowered a bucket into the well and found him.
The Egyptian official who bought him and told his wife to honour him.

answers.canonical: The women who cut their hands
answers.explanation: Guests given knives were so struck by his beauty that they cut their hands.

answers.canonical: The king's dream of seven cows
answers.explanation: He interpreted the king's dream of seven fat and seven lean cows as years of plenty and famine.
He interpreted the dreams of two young men in prison with him.
He was sold for a small price, a few dirhams.
His younger full brother, kept in Egypt by a plan; named in tradition.
The king's drinking cup was placed in Binyamin's bag so Yusuf could keep him.
His father's eyes turned white with grief and his sight returned when the shirt was cast over his face.
He asked to be put in charge of the storehouses of the land.
Ya'qub said, "Patience is most fitting" — sabrun jamil.

questions.prompt: Name a member of Prophet Yusuf's (AS) family.

answers.explanation: His father, a prophet.
Ten older brothers who were jealous of him.
His younger full brother; named in tradition.
His grandfather: "as He completed it on your fathers before, Ibrahim and Ishaq".
His great-grandfather, whose way Yusuf said he followed.
His mother, Rachel, according to tradition.
The eldest stayed behind in Egypt rather than face his father; tafsir names him Rubil or Yahudha.

questions.prompt: Name a dream from Surah Yusuf.

answers.canonical: Eleven stars, the sun and the moon
answers.explanation: Yusuf saw them prostrating to him.

answers.canonical: Seven fat cows and seven lean cows
answers.explanation: The king's dream: seven lean cows eating seven fat ones.

answers.canonical: Seven green ears of corn and seven dry
answers.explanation: The second half of the king's dream.
One prisoner dreamt he was pressing wine — he would serve the king again.
The other prisoner dreamt birds ate bread from his head — he would be crucified.
Years later his parents and brothers fell down in prostration: "This is the interpretation of my dream of before."

questions.prompt: Name an animal mentioned in Surah Yusuf.

answers.explanation: The brothers claimed a wolf had eaten him.
Seven fat and seven lean, in the king's dream.
Birds eating bread from the prisoner's head.
"A camel's load" of grain was promised for the king's cup.

questions.prompt: Name a place in the story of Prophet Yusuf (AS).

answers.explanation: Where he was sold and later ruled.
Where his brothers threw him.
Where he spent several years.
Where the wife of al-'Aziz closed the doors on him.
Ya'qub told his sons to enter by different gates.
He was put in charge of the storehouses of the land.
"He brought you out of the desert" — the family's home, Canaan in tradition.
He raised his parents onto the throne.

questions.prompt: Name a quality Prophet Yusuf (AS) is praised for.

answers.explanation: He refused the wife of al-'Aziz: "I seek refuge in Allah."
He was given half of all beauty.
"No blame on you today; Allah will forgive you."
The prisoner called him "Yusuf, O man of truth".
Allah taught him the interpretation of events and dreams.
The king said: "Today you are with us firmly established and trusted."
"Whoever fears Allah and is patient — Allah does not let the reward of the good-doers be lost."
"We gave him judgement and knowledge."
"Thus We reward the doers of good (muhsinin)."
"He was of Our chosen (mukhlasin) servants."
"The noble son of the noble son of the noble son of the noble: Yusuf son of Ya'qub son of Ishaq son of Ibrahim."

questions.prompt: Name something Prophet Yusuf's (AS) brothers did.

answers.explanation: "Throw him into the bottom of the well."
"Kill Yusuf or cast him out to some land."
They came weeping at night and said a wolf had eaten him.

answers.canonical: Brought the shirt with false blood
answers.explanation: They brought his shirt stained with false blood.
In the famine they came to buy food and did not recognise him.
Their father made them swear an oath by Allah.
Their goods had been put back in their saddlebags.

answers.canonical: Said his brother had stolen before
answers.explanation: "If he steals — a brother of his has stolen before."

answers.canonical: Asked their father to seek forgiveness
answers.explanation: "O our father, ask forgiveness for us of our sins."
They fell down before him in prostration, fulfilling the dream.

questions.prompt: Name something Prophet Ya'qub (AS) said or did in Surah Yusuf.

answers.explanation: Sabrun jamil — his answer to the news of Yusuf and later of Binyamin.

answers.canonical: Told Yusuf to keep the dream secret
answers.explanation: "Do not relate your vision to your brothers."

answers.canonical: Feared a wolf would eat him
answers.explanation: "I fear that a wolf would eat him."

answers.canonical: Wept until his eyes turned white
answers.explanation: His eyes became white from grief.

variants: Innama ashku bathi wa huzni ilallah
answers.explanation: "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allah."
"Go and find out about Yusuf and his brother, and do not despair of relief from Allah."
"Do not enter from one gate, but from different gates."
"I find the smell of Yusuf."

answers.canonical: Promised to seek forgiveness for his sons
variants: I will ask forgiveness for you
answers.explanation: "I will ask forgiveness for you from my Lord."

questions.prompt: Name someone Prophet Yusuf (AS) met in Egypt.

answers.explanation: The official who bought him.
She tried to seduce him; tradition names her Zulaykha.
He freed Yusuf and gave him authority.
Two young men who entered prison with him.
They gossiped, then cut their hands at the sight of him.
A witness from her household judged by the torn shirt; some narrations say it was a baby.
The freed cupbearer forgot to mention him to the king for years.

questions.prompt: Name an object mentioned in Surah Yusuf.

answers.explanation: His shirt: with false blood, torn from behind, and cast over his father's face.
The king's cup, hidden in Binyamin's bag.
He raised his parents on the throne.
A water-drawer let down his bucket and found him.
Each woman at the banquet was given a knife.
She closed the doors; they raced to the door.
Carried on a prisoner's head in his dream.
She prepared a banquet with cushions for the women.
Their goods were put back in their saddlebags.
He was sold for a few dirhams.
